parsed.answer: This request (searching in English as well as your display language in the Command Palette) has been reported before. PowerToys#46304 asks for exactly this for the PowerToys Command Palette. The maintainer replied that a partial mechanism exists (for Pinyin) and that the open questions are how deep it should go, the performance overhead, and how to represent it in the API; they cross-referenced #38593 and #42346. In Windows Terminal, the same request (terminal#10196, terminal#13696) was closed as a duplicate of terminal#7039, and Terminal 1.24 now searches in both English and your display language. There is no confirmed fix for PowerToys Command Palette in these tickets, so please add your Spotlight-style Chinese/English scenario as a comment on PowerToys#46304 and follow it for updates. Meanwhile, Windows Terminal's Command Palette already supports this in version 1.24 or later.
